questions.prompt: The roadmap says to formalize: Paper, Claim, Evidence, Figure, Table, Method, Result, Citation. Which of these need NEW database tables vs just formalizing existing structures?
questions.description: Currently: Document (Paper), Chart (Figure), Evidence exist. ClaimDiff exists but is for verification only. Table has schema defined but no implementation. Method, Result, Citation don't exist.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Create new tables for: Claim, Table, Method, Result, Citation. Formalize existing Document/Chart/Evidence with stable IDs.

options.label: Create new tables for Claim, Table, Method, Result, Citation
Only add Table (already has schema). Method/Result/Citation are fields, not entities
Create ALL as separate entities with own tables

questions.prompt: Method, Result, Citation — should these be separate entities with their own IDs, or fields within Paper/Document?
questions.description: Currently PaperSummary has methodology, findings, conclusions as strings. Should these become structured entities?
questions.recommendedAnswer: Separate entities with IDs — enables cross-paper comparison and evidence linking.

options.label: Separate entities with own tables and IDs
Method/Result as entities, Citation as field

questions.prompt: Should these new entities be extracted during the existing analysis pipeline, or added later via a separate process?
questions.description: Current pipeline: intake → simplify → verify → chapters → charts. Where do Method/Result/Citation extraction fit?
questions.recommendedAnswer: Add to existing pipeline — extract Method/Result/Citation during simplify stage alongside claims.

questions.prompt: How should we handle backward compatibility with existing data?
questions.description: Existing documents don't have Method/Result/Citation data. Should we backfill or leave null?
questions.recommendedAnswer: Leave null for existing documents — no backfill. New entities only for new analyses.

options.label: Leave null for existing docs, extract for new analyses only

questions.prompt: Currently ClaimDiff stores original vs simplified claims for verification. Should the new Claim entity replace ClaimDiff or coexist?
questions.description: ClaimDiff is used for simplification verification. New Claim entity would be for structured research claims.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Coexist — ClaimDiff for verification, Claim for structured research claims with evidence links.

options.label: Replace ClaimDiff with new Claim entity
Merge into Claim entity with verification flag
